text: During ripening the rind is repeatedly worked with a smear of Brevibacterium linens, which forms a thin yellow-brown rind. The flavour runs from mild to strong and spicy depending on age. The paste is supple, with the irregular shiny eyes and cracks typical of Tilsiter.
